content:
I've been asked to take part in a (physics) panel discussion and to answer the question

"What skills are most important for a PhD student starting in 2026 to either protect or acquire?"

I have my own ideas, but thought I would 'crowd-source' a bit. Does anyone have any good ideas for this in the context of Lean and formalization?

You always learn most by working on hard problems. The area might be changing but wherever it is there will always be hard problems at the boundary. Work on hard problems and you'll learn perseverance.
